_readme: Base avatars for races that currently render as a HUMAN body (modelRace() in src/data/hair.ts
falls through to 'human' for anything outside its 7 patterns - silently, with no warning).
Generated BALD and in plain undergarments on purpose. The existing 7 races have clothing baked
into their single texture atlas, so any fitted garment sits on top of a painted-on tunic. New
races come out clean by construction, so the wardrobe works properly on them.
TRIPO: same settings as armor (HD Model, 2K texture, 30000 polycount) PLUS the T-Pose toggle,
which replaces the long pose paragraph from the source species sheet and gives auto-rig a
Only Tier A/B humanoid bipeds are listed. Tier C (wings, quadruped, four arms, ooze) will not
AccuRig cleanly and cannot borrow the shared biped animation clips - they need their own project.
AFTER generation: AccuRig pass -> convert-idle-to-glb.cjs -> prune-static-channels.cjs, then wire
ModelRace + modelRace() in hair.ts AND the asset consts in CharacterViewport.tsx. Borrow the human
anims initially, exactly as Halfling/Tiefling/Gnome already do.
